eip155_chain_id.source: Rollup0 Network Specification Appendix D; development profile only

eez_rollup_id.source: Rollup0 Network Specification Appendix D; EEZL2 immutable ROLLUP_ID

native_asset.value: Rollup0 development test asset; no production backing claim
native_asset.source: Rollup0 Network Specification Appendix D and §7.5

value.chiado_derivation: Apply Appendix D.6 to an activation-record Chiado timestamp-source block and publish the resulting artifact SHA-256, state root, and block hash.

value.validation: The pinned development chain activates these semantics from genesis. A production profile must publish its own complete fork schedule.

eez_contract.reason: The selected settlement-host profile owns the shared EEZ deployment identity.

manager_contract.issue: Pin the production Rollup0 manager address and bytecode hash.

proof_system_contracts.issue: Replace the development mock and pin every production ECDSA proof-system address and bytecode hash.

deployment_block.reason: The selected settlement-host profile owns the shared EEZ deployment block.

settlement_rule.value: A batch endpoint is settled only from exact canonical receipts for its post and transaction-indexed riders. Classify every transient index from ordered ImmediateEntrySkipped or L2ExecutionPerformed logs and every inbound index from its rider's ordered ExecutionConsumed plus L2ExecutionPerformed pair; preserve transaction boundaries, log order, indices, and multiplicity, then require one applied prefix. Root values or event counts alone are insufficient.
settlement_rule.source: Rollup0 Network Specification §4.5, §6, and Appendix E.9

finality_rule.value: An L2 block is safe after its matching Chiado settlement and finalized when that Chiado block is finalized.

value.priority_fee_treatment: credited to the zero beneficiary and economically inaccessible

system_address.source: Rollup0 Network Specification Appendix D; public development identity only

value.private_key_scope: Public development fixture only; a production profile must select a distinct secret or a new authorization design.
value.ordering: outbound [load,user] pairs, inbound deliveries, remaining users

sequencing_authority.issue: Pin the production operator identity and rotation procedure.

value.bundle_order: postAndVerifyBatch followed by inbound riders in batch order
value.inclusion_rule: Include the exact raw transactions together at the selected Chiado block number and timestamp or include none.
value.failure_rule: Reject a missing, extra, interposed, reordered, substituted, or independently droppable rider.

proof_routing_mitigation.issue: Activate a versioned contract or authenticated submission rule that binds the postAndVerifyBatch caller, transientExecutionEntryCount, transientLookupCallCount, replay domain, and front-running/failure behavior. Complete-calldata validator checks alone do not repair the 5c51e02 proof digest.

value.attestation_model: Permissioned threshold of independent single-signer ECDSA proof-system contracts

model.source: Rollup0 Network Specification §1 and §4.3; Appendix E.5

allowed_proof_systems_and_vkeys.issue: Publish the production accepted proof systems, signer identities, and manager-held verification keys.

threshold.issue: Pin the production validator count M and required threshold N.

requirement.value: Publish all user transactions and L1-shape derivation entries needed for byte-identical derivation from the settlement host, with exact sidecar-to-batch correspondence.

codec.value: tag 0x00 followed by canonical RLP [blockTxCounts, transactions, l2_entries]

derivation_rule.value: Derive only canonical batches using exact transaction receipts and ordered EEZ log occurrences with multiplicity; rebuild user and system transactions in block order and accept only a unique applied prefix.

manager_authority.value: The per-rollup manager selects proof policy and may call setStateRoot outside a block in which settlement locked the rollup.

upgrade_policy.issue: Publish contract upgrade, manager replacement, key rotation, and parameter-change procedures.

reorg_and_emergency_rule.value: Rewind and rederive after a Chiado reorg; validate canonical receipts before requeue; halt for operator intervention if automatic history is exceeded or a finalized settlement is displaced.
